hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *apps/frontend/app/*|*apps/frontend/components/*) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\",\"additionalContext\":\"Reminder (CLAUDE.md Design source of truth): before writing $f, check the matching page in design/static_html/*.html for exact layout/copy/interaction. If no mockup exists for this route/component, proceed but flag the gap explicitly rather than guessing.\"}}" ;; esac; }

cmd="$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')"
case "$cmd" in
  *"git commit"*)
    staged="$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null)"
    if printf '%s\n' "$staged" | grep -qE '^(docs/rest-api\.md|packages/shared-types/.*\.ts)$' \
       && ! printf '%s\n' "$staged" | grep -qE '^postman/Expertly\.postman_collection\.json$'; then
      reason="docs/rest-api.md or packages/shared-types/*.ts is staged for this commit but postman/Expertly.postman_collection.json is not. Per CLAUDE.md (Postman collection section) the collection must be updated in the same commit, or confirm this change genuinely does not affect the API contract."
      jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'
    fi
    ;;
esac
